svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.text: HLD 4 — Availability and disaster recovery: zone loss (automatic), data loss (restore), region loss (DR promotion)
Southeast Asia — primary region, three availability zones
East Asia — DR region (designed, before wave 2)
Zone loss: the standby is promoted under the same name; apps retry with the same batch_uuid. Data loss: PITR to a new server, phones re-send rows after the restore point (server generation).
